## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      2 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 26, 2026 - Aug 31, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Gekkenhuis13:48.$_, Aug 31, 2026, 1/5: "I signed up for this app and had 7 day free trial and if I cancelled within those days I would not be charged. I cancelled on the 3rd day and they have charged my card. I have sent them an email and no one replied to my email. I dispute the transaction with my bank and the next day they charge it again. Not sure how this happens. Don’t be fooled."
            2. _Howmanystepstoleaeareview_, Aug 26, 2026, 1/5: "Logged in for the first time in a while, reset my password, and instead of being able to poke around the app and see if it’s what I want to pay for I got locked behind a paywall. Can’t look at nothing besides pay them money Uninstalled"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jan 24, 2026 - Apr 25, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _mo4958589594_, Jan 24, 2026, 2/5: "The app has so much potential but is so broken. It alerts me on the wrong days, it does a ludicrous amount of reps and weight for where I’m at in my fitness ability, it will give me 6 exercises for my biceps in one day when my split is meant to be full body every work out. It COULD be great, but it’s not there. I won’t be renewing my subscription"
